newsitem.title: USA: Kleinwort continues div, gives extra div.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort continues div, gives extra div.

text.p: The board of directors of Kleinwort Benson Australian Income Fund Inc said on Tuesday it would continue to pay its monthly dividend at the current rate of $0.065 per share through May 1997 and would pay an extra dividend of $0.03 per share for 1996.
Payment for a monthly dividend and the special dividend will be on January 15, 1997 to shareholders of record on December 24 1996. The fund will make no capital gains distribution for 1996.
Kleinwort's principal investment objective is to produce high current income for U.S. investors through investment primarily in Australian dollar denominated debt securities of Australian issuers.
